groups.title: Foundations
groups.blurb: Decide these first. Later items depend on them.

groups.title: Payments
groups.blurb: How money moves and what happens when it fails.

groups.title: Wording
groups.blurb: Terms and copy the spec uses inconsistently.

items.title: Guest checkout or accounts only?
items.issue: The spec says both "no sign-up required" and "orders are saved to the customer's account".
items.rec: Allow guest checkout, and offer to create an account after payment.

items.title: Which launch markets?
items.issue: Tax, currency and payment methods all depend on the countries served, and the spec names none.
items.rec: Name the launch countries, then revisit sections B and C.

items.title: Add measurable success criteria
items.issue: "Checkout should feel fast" can't be tested.
items.rec: Target: p95 time from Pay to confirmation under 3 seconds, and at most 3 screens.

items.title: What happens when a payment times out?
items.issue: The customer may be charged without seeing a confirmation, then pay again.
items.rec: Show "checking your payment" and poll for up to 60 seconds before offering a retry. Never charge twice for one order.

items.title: Local payment methods
items.issue: Cards alone cover a minority of payments in some launch markets.
items.rec: Support the most-used local method in each launch market from day one.

items.title: "Order" and "purchase" are used interchangeably
items.issue: Support staff and the API docs will copy whichever word they see.
items.rec: Use "order" everywhere. Keep "purchase" only for the button label.
